text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the final day of summer camp, and
Air Shakur
continues to train until the
very last second.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I was just thinkin'...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The last time we came here was after the

Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: We've changed. You and me both.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You almost keeled over last year. That
means you
must've learned something.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
According to Parcae's calculations, I had
a zero
percent chance of makin' it this
far.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But stack enough 0.01 millimeter
increments and
you'll get one millimeter
eventually.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Once you reach one millimeter, the way
you
compile the rest is up to you. That's
freedom.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh?
choice_data_list: なら、君はもっと強くなれるね
なら、貴方はもっと強くなれるね
choice_data_list_en: Then you can become even stronger.
Then you can become even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well, guess you could say I'm used to it.
choice_data_list: 積み重ねるのは得意だろう
積み重ねるのは得意でしょう
choice_data_list_en: Building things up is your strong suit, right?
Building things up is your strong suit, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine's Security Officer
text_block_list.text:
Forgive my impertinence, Your
Highness, but I fear you
might hurt
yourself if you focus so intently.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
While I appreciate your concern, I assure
you I
can handle this much without issue.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I want to savor this wonderful sensation
a little
longer. It feels like my heart is
riding the wind and
soaring far into the
unknown...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That is to say, one more lap and I'll call
it a day.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Meh. Not as much as carrying out her
duty,
apparently.
choice_data_list: あの子、走るのが好きなんだな
あの子、走るのが好きなんだね
choice_data_list_en: She really loves running, doesn't she?
She really loves running, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I believe that if I do what I must, the two
of us will
see eye-to-eye one day.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: So annoyin'.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Air Shakur views Fine Motion
as
resigning herself to fate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In truth, I don't know anything for sure
right now.
However, if there's anything
she doesn't like, she
deals with it. On
that note...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: 君のスタンスをわからせることはできる
貴方のスタンスをわからせることはできる
choice_data_list_en: We can make sure they understand your stance.
We can make your stance crystal clear to them.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Zero percent chance that happens.
choice_data_list: 今からの君を見れば、心も変わるかも
今からの貴方を見れば、心も変わるかも
choice_data_list_en: If they see what you do from here on, their minds might change.
If they see what you do from here on, their minds might change.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Zilch. Although, if she did...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, it'll be a pain if she sees us
here. Let's
go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so ends Shakur's senior-year
summer camp.
